find.match_belief: What initially drew me to the entertainment industry was my love for K-pop. I’ve always been fascinated by how K-pop goes beyond music. It combines storytelling, visuals, fashion, and community to create such a strong connection between artists and fans. That interest grew into wanting to understand the business and creative work behind the industry and how entertainment can bring people from different cultures together.

profile.belief: I was always the one friend that everyone would be directed to for a recommendation of a film or show. Watching TV was a huge escape for me, but I hadn't been surrounded by others that shared that same escape or passion for television. It wasn't until I came to college and found like-minded roommates that loved watching and analyzing TV as much as I did that I realized how satisfied and fulfilling it was to find people who shared that same interest with me--especially because it was something I engaged in so often. Additionally, I've always been a super creative person. I grew up creating art, writing, reading, and consuming media. I love creating creative assets for platforms and brands I am truly passionate about. This has definitely shaped my personality to be someone who highly values human connection and understanding people and consumers, which I realized is also weighed very heavily in the entertainment industry. It's a people business, which is where I knew I'd truly thrive in! So combining watching TV with my roommates every single night and being someone who is interested in creatively supporting these platforms, I realized being part of this industry was something that tied into both my passions, and something that would continuously challenge me. And for the first time, I am not the only one in the room who has watched so many movies/TV series!
profile.working_on: My ultimate goal in pursuing entertainment is to contribute to something larger than myself, and impact someone's life with the change or contribution that I make. Especially in entertainment, the stories and narratives it tells can influence and impact people's lives so deeply, connecting communities and passions and interests. So ultimately, I just want to know that I was a part of something that made an impact for the better, whether that be from a marketing standpoint, director standpoint, or producing standpoint. Or just from a people standpoint.
